name: ALKOS Apartments Booking
description: Premium apartment booking and availability management system for ALKOS Apartments, Geita.

MONGODB_URI.description: MongoDB connection string for bookings, apartments, reviews, gallery and settings.

SESSION_SECRET.description: Secure session secret generated automatically by Heroku.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password used to access the ALKOS Apartments admin dashboard.

WHATSAPP_NUMBER.description: WhatsApp number that receives booking notifications. International format without + or spaces.

GOOGLE_MAPS_URL.description: Google Maps location for ALKOS Apartments.
